description.zh: 是否全部删除，仅当TagKeys为空时有效。取值范围：true或false，默认是false。当该参数为false时，TagKeys则是必选参数。
description.en: Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter takes effect only if TagKeys is left empty. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false. TagKeys is required if this parameter is set to false.

The IDs of the resources for which you want to modify the resource group. The number of resource IDs is 1 to 50.

*   If you set ResourceType to template, specify ResourceIds in the \["TemplateName1","TemplateName2"] format.
*   If you set ResourceType to parameter, specify ResourceIds in the \["Name1","Name2"] format.
*   If you set ResourceType to secretparameter, specify ResourceIds in the \["Name1","Name2"] format.
*   If you set ResourceType to stateconfiguration, specify ResourceIds in the \["StateConfigurationId 1","StateConfigurationId 2"] format.
*   If you set ResourceType to application, specify ResourceIds in the \["Name1","Name2"] format.

description.zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：

- template: 模板。
- parameter: 参数。
- secretparameter: 加密参数。
- stateconfiguration: 终态配置。
- application: 应用。
description.en:
The type of the resource for which you want to modify the resource group. Valid values:

*   template: template.
*   parameter: parameter.
*   secretparameter: encryption parameter.
*   stateconfiguration: desired-state configuration.
*   application: application.

description.zh: 标签键列表，键的数量限制为1至20。
description.en: The tag keys. The number of keys ranges from 1 to 20.

title.zh: 删除用户标签资源关系

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids '[templateName1, templateName2]' --resource-type template --tag-keys '[k1, k2]' --all false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceIds '["templateName1","templateName2"]' --ResourceType template --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TagKeys '["k1","k2"]'
